review_text: Great smartwatch for the money. It does everything the listing stays it will do, and it is very easy to use. Download the app and do easy set up. Great smartwatch!
Watch was fine, at first. The watch is now 7th months old, and is no longer working. Even inexpensive watches, should last for at least a year.

Battery life is very good, accurate for heart rate and Oxygen levels and able to receive messages and calls. Also able to answer calls. I especially like the monitoring of my cycling for heart rate etc. I am happy with purchase.

I bought this mainly to track my exercise, however it is very easy to accidentally pause or turn off the tracking when in exercise mode, with movements of the wrist. This means it actually isn't tracking activity, when you think it is. I really don't have the opportunity to constantly check my watch while exercising.

These are my second replacements, they do not even fit in ear snugly, sound quality poor, doesn't cancel out background noise even if sound through turned off. Very disappointed, you need monster shrek ears for these to even fit. Took over a month to get the replacements back. You know they a refurbished, I paid for new not refurbished. Hitting up social media to crush this company's hype. Sincerely, Professional stunt Actor and Public figure.

Is not what they show In The picture. I was very disappointed and sent it back. Wouldn’t read the SIM card ( kept saying to please insert it.). The holes to the wrist weren’t punched out. The camera was very cheap and bad quality. Since all the other watches seemed to be around the same price I thought that that’s just the price of these watches. I would not recommend these at all

I will take this watch over a fit bit any day! In fact my husband bought me a fit bit and I returned it because thus watch is soooo much better. What I like most is the BATTERY LIFE IS AMAZING! I bought it weeks ago and have only charged it twice.

The watch is for my 6 yo niece and the set up took a long time because it freezes and does not respond to the touch screen. the lag with the touch screen commands were frustrating and it takes a 3-4 seconds to move onto the app, or opening anything. I know this is no PulseFit but the delay in responsiveness made this tough for a child to use.
It has all the tracking functions I need, and is easy to use. Highly recommended!
Some of the functions I don't have the need to use, but those that I do use perform perfectly. The extra watch band was a plus. Well worth the price.

The watch looks beautiful, but there are some issues. The seller sent us a U.K. model and the wall plug is this huge UK plug with an adapter. The battery life is crap as it did not last a full day on normal usage. The watch did not automatically update the operating system and unless you were aware you would be using the outdated software. I would not recommend unless you want to lug the charger with you wherever you go.

This is my third Gamin watch I normally can get at least 3 years out of the watch and yest i use it twice a day 5-6 times a week. So i do get my money's worth from this watch. I don't have to use the manual to get this watch going so that's a big plus. Great Watch AR
Watch is nice, the buckle broke off the band after a few days, but we were able to get a replacement for about $8. it was hard to change because there were no instructions, but we got it.
My daughter loves it. Works great and easy to use

It didn't have any manual or anything written enclosed to help a novice like me get it charged up and working. I'm waiting for my son to arrive for setup help. It looks like new with no scratches, no blemishes or other indications of wear.
Yardage were accurate but it was very difficult to read the screen .
The watch itself is good but the manual doesn't explain real clear what to do .
Nice watch not with good battery life and small screen. Returned it because it has small screen and it's wristband is terrible.

dismal battery life, yet small which is good for sleeping, however, not worth it to me. Got the Galaxy 5 instead. The LTE DID work with PulseFit Fi. Best wait for Gen2. Very awesome watch! Looks great, lots of functions and abilities easy to use and put on or off your arm , great price for its value!

I am really enjoying my watch. I am into tech, but I was surprised by the learning curve. I love the color and get compliments on it all the time. Everyone says it looks like an PulseFit. HAH.

Love the feel and color. Exactly what I ordered!

I am loving my new Smart Watch! I like that it tracks my sleeping pattern and monitors my oxygen saturation and bpms. The mobile app is user friendly. I didn't have any issues with the settings. I'll have to do an update regarding battery life bc I haven't had it long enough. The only thing I didn't like was the screen protector. I had a difficult time putting it on without seeing air bubbles. Would be great if it already came with one!
The heart rate monitor is wrong, sometimes doesn't connect for calls and texts, step tracker is inaccurate, kind of a garbage purchase
He loves it and is using it to get some good exercise if only inside due to the rain we are having.
This thing is great. Does everything you would expect and the battery lasts FOREVER!! Great smartwatch.

Good display, bakery life, exercise tracker, n monitors. GPS is helpful. Only wish for a calenar.

I use as a basic watch to track my steps that’s pretty much it I wanted a different style from my iPhone watch. It’s good as basic watch and are counter. It does give heart rate and etc but I don’t really mess with it. The battery lasts me about a week (I turn the watch off every night after 8-9 hour day at work). I did scratch the screen on something which sucks but it doesn’t affect the watch function at all. It was delivered in good time as well.
I have to change my wrists every day or so because the band irritates them, I drive a school bus and that shows 2000 steps each run so 4000 a day. It also shows 200 steps a day while driving my car.

Not the best product for the money.

This is a really great watch for working out and keeping track of your steps and blood pressure your stress level.
I like all the different features, dislikes, battery life too short

This watch looks really cool. It's a bit bulky and heavy but it is built really nicely and that comes at a cost even though that isn't reflected in the price. It has all the features all the fancy watches have at a fraction of the price and looks great. Also, the battery is 10 times better than any other watch I've seen.

Was liking it for about 2 weeks and then it wouldn't hold a charge. I would give it 2 hours on the charger and it would be dead in about 90 minutes. Tried all the troubleshooting methods or restarting, updating and all...totally crap product

Had a conversation with someone who couldn't tell it was thru the watch instead of the phone... Very clear. I do wish it came with a manual or website too show you all the features but great watch.

The faces don’t smoothly change from one to another. My watch seemed to trip up quite a bit when doing so. It also has limited sports modes which is why I’ll actually be returning it. It’s a shame because I love the style!

Like the sound quality, really clear. Charger fast. Didn’t like volume and noise cancellation. Thought the volume didn’t get high enough to cancel the outside noises. Also the control buttons, you have to press kind of hard and can hurt ones ears.
I like everything about this except that I didn’t realize that the frame and the band would be a Brilliant white! There is a golden strip surrounding the watch face.

This is a great lightweight fitness tracker. It has about a 4 day battery life and does a quick recharge. It has a little learning curve for the activity tracking but it is right up there with my PulseFit.

I purchased my Bip U Pro on 10/29/21. It works well except the GPS. If your sleeve covers the watch, it might lose the signal, especially if your sleeve is damp or wet. Hard to do when you live in Oregon! The app works well, not every parameter is accurate, but gives you an indication of what is being measured.

It’s a good watch for the basic telling time, counting steps or heart rate. For anything else I don’t suggest it. It refuses to connect to my PulseFit phone to alert me of text messages or anything else. The watchband is also not very durable. I am now on Amazon looking for another watch band because mine broke already in two months.
Horrible battery life, difficult to connect and stay connected to satellite. Returned it.
Excellent product. I have owned my own for over 2 years and love it. This was for a gift and they love it too.

My wife loves this very much, she has now her phone on her writs though her cell phone may be in another room. So no matter where she goes in the house or yard, if the cell phone rings, it rings on this wrist device.

Happy with my purchase. I had a vivo active 3 before, which met an untimely departure from my wrist and is now at the bottom of a lake. I got this watch, which was less than the vivo actives, and I am happy I didn't spend the extra as it does everything I want.

Nice looking watch with accurate steps. I love the gps feature where it shows your walk on a true map on the app. Nice visual. Heart rate is very accurate as well. Haven't used music feature as much as I thought I would. PulseFit makes a nice watch. Highly recommend.
